title: T2ST: Data-Efficient Spatio-Temporal Foundation Models via Temporal Data and Knowledge Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2611.18199v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spatio-temporal foundation models (STFMs) require large-scale training corpora, yet synchronized observations and spatial metadata are costly to acquire and curate, limiting the availability of suitable data. By contrast, time-series data are abundant and easier to collect. Since observations at each location form a time series, this motivates a natural question: can abundant time-series data enhance STFMs when spatio-temporal observations are scarce? To bridge this gap, we propose T2ST, a data-efficient training framework that augments limited spatio-temporal observations with selected auxiliary time series and transfers knowledge from a frozen time-series foundation model. Our key insight is that temporal pattern learning can benefit from abundant external time series, while spatial dependency learning remains grounded in real spatio-temporal observations. Guided by this insight, T2ST retrieves matched sequences to reinforce sparsely

translated_title: T2ST：通过时间数据与知识迁移实现数据高效的时空基础模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.18199v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：时空基础模型（STFMs）需要大规模训练语料，然而同步观测和空间元数据的获取与整理成本高昂，限制了合适训练数据的可获得性。相比之下，时间序列数据丰富且更易于收集。由于每个位置的观测本身构成了一个时间序列，这引出了一个自然的问题：当时空观测稀缺时，丰富的时间序列数据能否增强时空基础模型？为弥合这一差距，我们提出了 T2ST，一个数据高效的训练框架，它利用精选的辅助时间序列来增强有限的时空观测，并从冻结的时间序列基础模型中迁移知识。我们的关键洞察是：时间模式学习可以从丰富的外部时间序列中受益，而空间依赖学习则仍然立足于真实的时空观测。基于这一洞察，T2ST 检索匹配的序列以强化稀疏的……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: T2ST 框架通过引入丰富的时间序列数据辅助训练，并从冻结的时间序列基础模型中迁移知识，在时空观测稀缺的情况下实现数据高效的时空基础模型训练。
en_tdlr: T2ST enables data-efficient training of spatio-temporal foundation models by augmenting scarce spatio-temporal observations with abundant auxiliary time-series data and transferring knowledge from a frozen time-series foundation model.
